summary: Backend-only testing of Jarvis Trading Bot API. All 19 pytest cases passed (100%). Validated service info flags (kimi_active=false, telegram_configured=false), chat with trading intent + task creation, all 4 mock feeds (trading 6 tickers + random-walk verified, twitter/calendar/news), bot status (starting cash $100k), trade execution (buy BTC, invalid symbol -> 400, insufficient cash -> 400), AI signal generation (heuristic fallback), approve/skip signal flows, auto-mode toggle, and full reset. Verified no MongoDB _id leakage in JSON responses.
critical_code_review_comments: trading_engine.execute_signal: when an approved SELL signal lacks an existing position, it fails silently (status='failed', exec_result holds error string). Consider emitting clearer error in API response on /bot/signal/{id}/approve so dashboard can show why.
bot/auto endpoint accepts loose dict; consider Pydantic model with explicit 'on: bool' for stronger validation.
telegram_bot.broadcast_signal opens a fresh httpx.AsyncClient per call inside polling logic — fine at low volume but a long-lived client could be reused if scaled.
scripted_reply intent matching uses substring on lowered text — 'monday' triggers calendar even in trading sentences. Acceptable for v1 fallback.
Mongo _id correctly excluded everywhere via projection {_id:0} or model_dump on uuid-id docs — verified.
test_credentials: Not required. MOONSHOT_API_KEY and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN intentionally empty; fallback heuristic mode confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: None. Suite calls /api/bot/reset before run for deterministic state, and again inside test_reset_clears_state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_jarvis_backend.py covers all 19 review-request cases. Suite auto-resets bot state at session start. Signal generation uses random-walk so suite retries up to 10/15 times to obtain a pending signal — keep this resilience if extending. Mocked: prices (random-walk), twitter/calendar/news (static), Kimi (scripted_reply fallback), Telegram polling (skipped without token).
